final_note: You learned what globalisation means for culture in the UK.

concepts.def: People spread far from a homeland
Mix of two or more cultures

walkthroughs.body_html:
Globalisation = trade, travel and media linking the world.

Result: cultures mix faster than ever. 🌐

Examples in UK life:

  • Chicken tikka masala — UK's favourite curry.
  • K-pop on Spotify.
  • US tech firms running our apps.
  • Italian coffee chains everywhere.

Hybrid culture blends elements.

British Bhangra, grime music, Brit-Asian comedy — all hybrids.

Some worry about Americanisation — losing local culture. Many love the mix. 🎶
